name: create-postgresql-database
description: Create application database if it does not exist and set owner

tasks.name: Create database with proper owner

commands.skipIf: sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='${db_name}'" | grep -q 1

assertions.message: Database should not already exist at this point

verification: sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='${db_name}'" | grep -q 1
